full_judgment: 27. In this case there is no dispute that the death of deceased Shahabuddin @ Mona as a result of gun fire on the date of occurrence. The post mortem examination reports corroborates this undisputed position. The defence has of course taken the plea that the occurrence did not take place in front of the house of Monir Miah near Battola and that deceased Shahabuddin @ Mona after coming from Chittagong on attending a marriage ceremony of his friend there came to know that the accused persons assaulted Alauddin @ Ploton and to take revenge deceased Shahabuddin @ Mona along with his accomplices went to the Bazar where they looted a shop of the brother of condemned prisoner Abdul Karim and that there was exchange of firing and due to exchange of firing in between the two groups deceased Shahabuddin @ Mona sustained gun shot injuries and as a result he died. It is also not disputed that one Alauddin @ Ploton was assaulted on the same day on 3-5-1990 at about 5.30 pm in front of the Hospital near the tea shop of one Abdur Rab which is near Upazila Hospital within Bashurhat Bangla Bazar Road when deceased Shahabuddin @ Mona was not present and for this Alauddin @ Ploton filed a case against the condemned prisoners and others under sections 147/ 48/326/ 323/ 379/ 34 of the Penal Code on 5-5-1990 being Companigonj PS Case No. 2 dated 5-5-1990 and this case initiated by Alauddin Ahmed Ploton resulted in conviction of the absconding condemned prisoners of the Death Reference, namely Siraj and Abdul Karim and others for the offence committed under sections 147//326/ 323/ 324/ 379/ of the Penal Code against which Criminal Appeal No. 30 of 1998 was preferred before the court of Sessions Judge, Noakhali which was dismissed summarily as being barred by limitation and against this order of the learned Sessions Judge one of the co-accused of this being Golam Rahman alias Masum preferred Criminal Revision No. 767 of 1998 before this court which was allowed by way of acquitting the said Golam Rahman alias Masum and setting aside the judgment and order of conviction and sentence passed by the Additional District Magistrate, Noakhali in Companigonj PS Case No. 2 dated 5-5-1990 corresponding to GR No. 15 of 1990. So it is apparent rather admitted that Alauddin @ Ploton was assaulted by the accused persons and others on 3-5-1990 at about 5.30 pm in front of shop of one A. Rab within Bashurhat Bangla Bazar Road which is a quite different place from that of the place of occurrence in the present case which allegedly took place near the house of accused Monir and his sons being convict Siraj and co-accused Farid under the Banyan tree as shown by the 10 in sketch map and index. Moreover, a suggestion from the defence was given to PW 3 Amirul Islam Khokon that the occurrence took place in front of Mitali Store where there was exchange of gun shots and deceased Shahabuddin @ Mona sustained gun shot injury and died and same suggestion was also given to PW 11 Mahmud Alam Munna that there was disturbance in front of the shop of the condemned prisoner Karim and that his shop was looted and for this there was fighting and that due to exchange of firing deceased Shahabuddin @ Mona sustained gun shot injury and died. So the suggestion as given from the side of the accused i.e., the defence to these PWs has a tendency to admit the fact that the occurrence did not take place in front of the shop of condemned prisoner Karim or Mitali Store. On the contrary the evidence given by the prosecution goes to show that the occurrence took place in front of the house of accused Monir and his sons Siraj and Farid near Battola on 3-5-1990 at about 7-30 pm and, as such, the contention of the learned State Defence Counsels for the condemned prisoners and also those of the learned Advocates for the convict appellants as was advanced during the time of argument that the occurrence did not take place at the time and place of occurrence does not stand and therefore falls through. Moreover, the learned Advocates for the condemned prisoners including the learned Advocate, for the convict appellants also argued that in the FIR there was no mention about the electric light as to the mode or means of recognition of the condemned prisoners and the convict appellants, but the PWs particularly PWs 1, 12 and 13 stated about the occurrence who recognized the condemned prisoners and others with the electric light of the house of accused Monir Miah. Though in the FIR there was no mention about the electric light by which they claim to have recognized, this omission does not in any way renders the prosecution case unbelievable in view of total sceneries when these PWs have particularly stated that they recognized the condemned convicts including the convict appellants with the electric light of the house of accused Monir. Besides, the informant PW 1 in his FIR also stated that he could recognize the condemned prisoners and other accused persons on the date of occurrence. So non mentioning about the means of recognition in the present case is simply an omission and not contradiction.
